components.name: Search / Ask Input
components.description: The primary action of the product: one rounded input that both live-filters and asks.
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--color-faint, #757269); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input-search { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(31 30 28 / 0.1)); background: var(--color-panel, #ffffff); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 96px 12px 44px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink, #1f1e1c); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(31 30 28 / 0.04); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-faint, #757269); } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgb(37 99 235 / 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.12); }

components.name: Ask Button
components.description: The only filled button in the product; appears inside the search input's right edge when a query exists.
components.css: .ds-btn-ask { background: var(--color-action, #2563eb); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-ask:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-ask:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-ask:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-action, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Quiet pill navigation; soft at rest, ink tint plus medium weight when active.
components.html: MeetingsThreads
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-soft, #6f6d67); transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #1f1e1c); } .ds-nav-link-active { background: rgb(31 30 28 / 0.06); font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #1f1e1c); }

components.name: Meeting Row
components.description: Flat divided list row: title and meta on one baseline, clamped summary below, whole row is a link.
components.html:
Weekly product sync

14 Aug, 15:02 · 4m 12s

Agreed to ship the search fusion scoring before the demo and moved the graph endpoint behind a feature flag until reranking stabilises.
components.css: .ds-row { display: block; margin: 0 -12px; padding: 16px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-ink, #1f1e1c); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(31 30 28 / 0.1)); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgb(31 30 28 / 0.03); } .ds-row-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-row-title { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-row-meta { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--color-soft, #6f6d67); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row-summary { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--color-soft, #6f6d67); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

components.name: Answer Panel
components.description: The synthesis response: the one content surface that earns a full white panel, with a hairline-topped sources line.
components.html:
Across the last three meetings the team converged on shipping search first and deferring the device firmware polish until after the demo.

Sources: Weekly product sync, Demo dry run
components.css: .ds-answer { background: var(--color-panel, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(31 30 28 / 0.1)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(31 30 28 / 0.04); } .ds-answer-p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--color-ink, #1f1e1c); animation: ds-set-line 450ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-answer-p strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-answer-sources { margin: 16px 0 0; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(31 30 28 / 0.1)); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--color-soft, #6f6d67); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-answer-src { color: var(--color-action, #2563eb); text-decoration: none; } .ds-answer-src:hover { text-decoration: underline; } @keyframes ds-set-line { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.25em); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

components.name: Topic Chip
components.description: Non-interactive topic tag: full-round, 5% ink tint, soft text.

components.name: Status Line
components.description: The pipeline's voice: exact words, pulsing blue while in flight, static red on failure. No spinners exist.
components.html:
Transcribing…

Failed: audio stream dropped
components.css: .ds-status { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status-inflight { color: var(--color-action, #2563eb); animation: ds-ink-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-status-failed { color: var(--color-danger, #d33a2f); } @keyframes ds-ink-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; } 50% { opacity: 0.9; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-inflight { animation: none; opacity: 0.6; } }

narrative.overview:
Echo is an AI meeting notetaker that looks the way the category is supposed to look, executed at full craft. The world is a warm near-white page carrying ink-dark text, structured by hairline dividers rather than boxes, with exactly one blue that means "act" and one red that means "failed". This is a user-chosen canon: an expressive galley-proof serif world was built first and rejected (seed 6280867b); basic and understandable beats expressive. Nothing on screen asks to be admired; everything asks to be read.

Density is a single reading column (42rem) that holds the wordmark, one search-or-ask input, and a flat divided list of meetings. The synthesis answer is the only content that earns a full white panel; everything else sits directly on the paper ground. Motion exists only as meaning: text lines settle in as notes arrive, statuses pulse while the pipeline works, and everything respects prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: One warm near-white ground, white panels only where content is "served" (input, synthesis answer)
Hairline dividers (1px at 10% ink) do all the structural work; no card grids
Inter Variable for every glyph, 15px base, tight semibold headings
One action blue used sparingly: links, statuses, focus, and a single filled button
Icons are hand-drawn inline SVG at ~1.6 stroke with round caps; never a glyph font or icon package
Copy uses middots (·) as separators and never an em dash

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue is the entire accent system. If something is interactive or in flight, it may be blue; nothing else may. It fills at most one button per screen.

rules.name: The Translucent Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders and dividers are always rgb(31 30 28 / 0.1) — ink at 10%, never an opaque gray. Hover and active tints are the same ink at 3–6%.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading, button, and status is sentence case. No uppercase labels, no kickers or eyebrows, no letterspaced smallcaps.

rules.name: The Middot Rule
rules.body: Meta fragments join with a spaced middot ("14 Aug, 15:02 · 4m 12s"). Copy never uses an em dash.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: 0 1px 2px rgb(31 30 28 / 0.04) is the entire shadow vocabulary at rest. Anything needing more separation gets a hairline or a panel background instead.

dos: Do keep every screen inside the 42rem column with hairline-divided flat lists; the white panel treatment is reserved for the input and the synthesis answer.
Do draw new icons inline as SVG at ~1.6 stroke with round linecaps, colored via currentColor or the token variables.
Do use the exact status vocabulary: "Transcribing…", "Writing notes…", "Failed: <error>", "Loading…" — pulsing opacity for in-flight, static red for failure.
Do join meta fragments with " · " and keep numbers tabular (.meta handles both the size and tabular-nums).
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback, as set-line, ink-pulse, and rec-pulse already have.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, a gradient, or a filled colored surface; blue text/ring is the ceiling for everything except the single Ask button.
Don't box content into cards or add shadows beyond 0 1px 2px rgb(31 30 28 / 0.04); separation comes from hairlines and whitespace.
Don't use uppercase labels, kickers/eyebrows, letterspaced headings, or any typeface other than Inter Variable.
Don't use em dashes in copy, spinners for progress, or icon fonts / icon packages.
Don't use pure #000 text or opaque gray borders; ink is #1f1e1c and lines are translucent ink.
